phases.name: Start a new game and pick a club
phases.description: Deliver the pure league generator, seed parsing, navigation state and the three phone-first screens so Sam reaches a chosen club in two taps.

steps.name: Generate a deterministic eight-club league
criteria: For any 32-bit seed the league holds exactly 8 clubs with non-empty unique names, unique ids and two distinct colours
The same seed yields a deep-equal league; seeds 1 and 4242 yield different leagues; boundary seeds 0, -1, max and min succeed
Generation uses only the seeded rng, with no ambient randomness or wall-clock time
No generated club name equals a real club name from the denylist unit test
steps.scenario_name: S-001 a league is generated from a seed > Given any 32-bit seed, when the league is generated > then it holds exactly 8 clubs @property @driving_port
steps.implementation_notes: Functional core: pure generateLeague(seed) => League, towns drawn without replacement for name uniqueness (ADR-0004), colours drawn from a palette as two distinct entries. Contract shape: pure-function, return-only. Remove the __SCAFFOLD__ marker and the throw. Add a unit test asserting no generated name (across many seeds) matches a real-club denylist (ADR-0004). Remaining league-generation.test.ts scenarios must pass too. deriveSeed is optional (needed by S-002).

steps.name: Parse seed from the web address
criteria: A valid 32-bit integer search value such as ?seed=007 parses to that number
Missing, empty, non-numeric, fractional or out-of-range seeds return DEFAULT_SEED
Parsing never throws for any input string
steps.scenario_name: S-001 the seed comes from the web address > Given an invalid or missing seed > then any non-numeric seed falls back to the default seed @property @error
steps.implementation_notes: Pure parseSeed(search: string) => number; location.search is read only in main.ts. Choose a fixed DEFAULT_SEED. Contract shape: pure-function. Remove the __SCAFFOLD__ marker. Also pass the valid-seed property in the same file.

steps.name: Navigate from title to club home
criteria: NewGame moves the title screen to pickClub
ChooseClub with a known id in pickClub moves to clubHome with that club chosen, league unchanged
ChooseClub outside pickClub or with an unknown id leaves the state unchanged
steps.scenario_name: S-001 Sam moves from the title to a chosen club > Given the title, when Sam taps New game, then the club list is shown @walking_skeleton @driving_port
steps.implementation_notes: Pure update(state, action) => GameState with Screen, Action (NewGame, ChooseClub) and GameState {league, screen} (ADR-0003). Chosen club held in memory only. Contract shape: pure-function. Remove the __SCAFFOLD__ marker; all five navigation scenarios must pass.

steps.name: Render title, pick-club and club-home screens
criteria: Tapping New game shows one h1 and a list named Clubs with 8 items, each holding one button of at least 44px height
Tapping a club shows an h1 containing that club's name; the colour swatch is aria-hidden
Same ?seed= gives the same league, different seeds differ, and an invalid seed gives the default league
No horizontal scroll at 390px and no console errors on title, club list and club home
steps.scenario_name: S-001 start a new game and pick a club > @walking_skeleton Sam taps New game, picks a club and lands on its home in 2 taps
steps.implementation_notes: Imperative shell (ADR-0002/0003): el() helper with no innerHTML of generated text; move src/ui/title-screen.ts to ui/screens/title.ts with a New game click that dispatches; render<Screen>(root, props, dispatch); main.ts is the composition root that reads location.search once, calls parseSeed and generateLeague, runs the update/render loop and moves focus to the new h1. Club = button in a ul named Clubs, first text line is the club name. Keep tests/e2e/shell.spec.ts passing. Integration/e2e tests stay single-example. All other tests in S-001-pick-club.spec.ts must pass.
